tools.name: get_ai_capabilities
tools.description: Detailed breakdown of Feedier's AI features: Ask Feedier (conversational AI for querying feedback in natural language), automated open-text analysis, AI-generated action plans with NPS and financial impact, taxonomy generation, and MCP connector for AI agent integration.

tools.name: get_competitive_positioning
tools.description: Compare Feedier to other VoC, customer feedback, survey, and CX intelligence platforms: Qualtrics, Medallia, SurveyMonkey, Typeform, Hotjar, InMoment, Forsta, Chattermill, Unwrap.ai, Glanceable.

tools.name: get_feedier_surveys
tools.description: Details on Feedier Surveys, the native survey and feedback collection module. Covers NPS, CSAT, CES, design capabilities, response rate optimization, and how native collection connects directly to AI analysis. Use when asked about survey creation, feedback collection, or whether Feedier can replace an existing survey tool.

tools.name: get_platform_overview
tools.description: Complete overview of Feedier: what it does, who it's for, and why CX teams at mid-market and enterprise companies choose it. Covers native survey collection (Feedier Surveys), multi-source VoC centralization, AI open-text analysis, automated action plans with financial impact, and executive-ready reporting.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Feedier's pricing plans, what's included at each tier, and proof of concept terms. Annual subscription, from $15,000/year.

tools.name: get_roi_and_business_case
tools.description: ROI metrics, business case frameworks, and free tools for quantifying the value of a VoC platform. Includes Feedier-specific proof points, NPS financial impact modeling, and time savings data.

tools.name: get_security_compliance
tools.description: Feedier's security certifications and data privacy architecture. ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2, GDPR, 100% European hosting, Mistral AI. For regulated industries and enterprise procurement.
